= Core goal =
We want a SPARQL endpoint which can answer queries efficiently based on a known data model. The data
model is defined as data types in the implementation, so that maximum information is available for
query planning and execution.
The fields in data types will be mapped to predicates.
If a SPARQL query contains a predicate which is not known, the query should error.



= Implementation =
- We will use Rust, but always prioritize simplicity over performance. It is okay to use clone()
  wherever needed.
- Reference material is available in the directory ./support.
- We should start with a minimal implementation, which only handles SELECT query without any
  filtering or named graphs.
